notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on a 1924 log cabin with cupola, about 16 miles northeast of Elk City. Abandonment is dated only to the 1930s (Idaho listing) or by the late 1930s (firelookout.com), so the abandoned event uses 1930 as a placeholder year for the decade. Both Vermillion pages say Disgrace Butte may have replaced it, two miles southwest; the Disgrace Butte page says the same tower may have replaced Vermillion Peak, two miles northeast. These two directions describe the same pair, so they are not a conflict. No staffing or fire history was found. Do not confuse with the Montana Vermillion Peak (Kootenai NF, 23N-29W-9, built 1936 per montanalookouts.weebly.com/vermillion-peak.html), which is a different lookout and was not used. The brief's kind 'ground' matches the FFLA list's 'Ground' type. No current access information was found.
